motion.frame: Three glTF Y-up; +X feed-to-die; all flow markers direct children of identity state groups
motion.screw: spin_axis=x on two pivot nodes per state; rotate both in same direction
motion.flow: vent_flow=solid|melt|atm_gas|vac_gas; vent_from and vent_to Three parent-local vectors; t=(phase+vent_phase)%1; lerp(from,to,t)
motion.focus: vent_focus=atm|vac|seal on static equipment meshes and compared element; includes nearby barrel context
motion.scope: directional explanation only, no timing, fill fraction, energy or residence prediction

mesh_reuse.method: byte-identical attributes, topology and materials; no simplification
